plan.title: Post-Auction Counter Offer Visible to Vendor

steps.note: Open the prepared converted-auction event on the buyer's Responses tab.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the active auction bid.
Send the buyer's counter offer at the specified price.
Assert that the buyer grid records the counter offer as initiated.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the vendor's auction pricing round where the pending counter offer is shown.
Assert that the vendor can see the pending counter offer.
Assert that the vendor has an Accept action.
Assert that the vendor has a Reject option.
Assert that the vendor has a Modify option.
